D5 — Foundation keeps deterministic planner + graph seam + hard item/byte/call/step/Core render bounds; progressive runtime and adaptive token budgeting stay post-foundation.

implementationSlices: S1 [DEPENDENCY_CONVERGENCE] — First action in probe-foundation.mjs: inspect exact DONE BB-060..063 exports/hashes and emit FOUNDATION_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST_V1 {workId,planHash,module,exports}. Require 060 exact-source providers, 061 context contract/Core resolver seam, 062 catalog/planner/provider contracts and 063 durability/currentness helpers. Missing/parallel/incompatible seam exits PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before resolution or writes. Verify: probe, foundation, architecture.

S2 [FOUNDATION_COMPOSITION,INV-1,INV-3] — Create packages/oracle/src/context-resolution.js and export createOracleContextResolver from dependency-delivered packages/oracle/src/index.js. resolve() composes delivered parse/identity -> authoritative pre-observe -> optional exact-key reuse -> deterministic planner/providers -> candidate normalization -> ContextResolution materialization -> post-observe -> optional receipt. No Agentic lifecycle import; Core remains injection-only. Verify: foundation, architecture, oracle-regression.

S3 [FOUNDATION_PROBE,INV-2] — Create scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/probe-foundation.mjs and test/oracle-context-intelligence-foundation.test.mjs. Probe executes one REPOSITORY CURRENT and one exact manifest-protected APPLICATION_ARTIFACT requirement and emits ORACLE_FOUNDATION_PROBE_V1 with requirementId/resolutionId/reuseKey/receiptId, validators/provenance, item/byte/call/step counters, rendered bytes, unchanged-source reuse and changed-source invalidation. Verify: probe, foundation, agentic-regression.

S4 [FAIL_CLOSED_ARCHITECTURE] — Create test/oracle-context-intelligence-architecture.test.mjs and add failure fixtures to the foundation test for every negativeVerificationCases row: provider/tool leakage, source/provider failure, weak/unverifiable CURRENT, index/pre-post drift, all budget overruns, ambiguity, graph-lineage gap, divergent reuse, manifest mismatch, ownership import leak and resolver failure dispatch. Each fixture asserts typed failure plus non-consumption/non-publication; pre-render failure asserts zero model/Capability/Resource/LiveObject dispatch. Verify: foundation, architecture.

S5 [BENCHMARK_HANDOFF] — Create scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/benchmark-profile.mjs and test/oracle-context-intelligence-benchmark-contract.test.mjs. --mode validate checks ORACLE_CONTEXT_BENCHMARK_V1 O0/O1 arms, exact fixed-factor identities, metric vector, UNKNOWN semantics, no paid/live dispatch, no cohort mutation and no fixture-to-value claim. Verify: benchmark, benchmark-boundary.

S6 [REGRESSION_LIVING] — After S1-S5 pass, run Oracle/Core/Agentic/package-consumer regressions, then update Oracle/Core Living architecture/state/workflow with only delivered facade/currentness/durability behavior; graph productization, planner optimization, progressive runtime, adaptive budgeting, async interaction and live profile acceptance remain NOT DELIVERED. Verify: oracle-regression, core-regression, agentic-regression, package-consumer, living-docs.

S7 [CONTINUATION_HANDOFF] — Create/update scripts/oracle-context-intelligence/README.md with semantic continuation and proposed BB-083..BB-088 only; ids remain non-authoritative until separate Blackboard allocation and BB-077..081 remain Core work. Worker does not edit docs/blackboard. Verify: benchmark-boundary, living-docs.

sourceAnchors.match: D5 — Core consumes the resolver by dependency injection; Core does not import Oracle implementation and Oracle imports neither Core nor Agentic Application.

D5 — itemDigest binds source snapshot, currentness validators, provenance and content; materialization.id binds normalized ordered items; resolutionId binds requirementId + step + status + materialization.id + unresolved state.

D5 — SourceCatalog separately registers a source snapshot authority capable of resolving/validating authoritative snapshots. A retrieval index cannot satisfy CURRENT merely by reporting its own indexed revision; stale indexedSnapshotRef versus authoritative snapshot is STALE.
D1 — Preserve BB-061 resolutionId unchanged. Add ContextResolutionReuseKey as sha256(canonical(requirementId + resolverConfigDigest + normalized sourceObservations + derivationInputs)).

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: An executable requirement -> Oracle -> provider(s) -> ContextResolution prototype preserves provenance/currentness and enforces a context budget.

sourceAnchors.match: Oracle is not an agent, Advisor, Worker, correctness authority, semantic-memory system or runtime context lifecycle.
D14 — Requirement-resolution failure or projection rejection occurs before model generation. Capability, Resource and LiveObject invocation counts remain zero for context resolution.

D17 — Unsupported language, stale index, missing/renamed symbol, ambiguous symbol, unproven graph fact and external response without a strong source validator map to explicit typed provider failures/unresolved reasons; no silent downgrade.

D10 — Cache-hit and fresh paths both double-fence currentness: authoritative pre-observation before lookup/materialization and post-observation before reuse publication/consumption must have identical normalized digest. Drift produces STALE_DURING_RESOLUTION and no current consumption/publication.
